morning.insight:
💡 금요일, 코스피 5,533 + 오세훈 2심 선고 + 밀린 보고서 정리의 날

**KOSPI, 7,000선 이탈 가속화 — 5,500선 사수 관건**
한 달 새 7,000→5,500으로 1,500p(-21%) 하락했습니다. 전일 반등 시도가 무산되며 기관 -4,599억 순매도가 지수 하락을 주도했습니다. 개인(+3,667억)과 외국인(+505억)이 방어에 나섰지만 역부족이었습니다. 글로벌 증시도 동반 약세 — 필라델피아 반도체 -6.72% 폭락이 반도체 업황 둔화 우려를 재점화했습니다. 다만 WTI $99대로 유가 상승이 지속되는 점은 물가 압력 측면에서 유의할 구간입니다.

**오늘 오세훈 2심 선고**
정치권 최대 변수입니다. 시장직 유지 여부와 대선 출마 여부가 갈리는 분수령으로, 선고 결과에 따라 정치 불확실성이 증시 투심에도 영향을 줄 수 있습니다. 오전 중 결과 확인이 필요합니다.

**AX-TF 밀림 리스크 — 오늘 꼭 정리**
Z-P6 AI tool 검토방안 보고서(10/19→밀림)와 Z-P8 경영진 Follow-up 갱신(10/22→밀림)이 동시에 밀려 있습니다. 오늘 정리해야 10/30 중간점검 준비가 가능합니다. 홍보(T-P13) 채용솔루션 최신화도 밀린 상태입니다.

**2027 전사전략회의 — 10/26 재무계획 취합 마감 임박**
다음주 월(10/26) 마감까지 주말 포함 실질 작업일 2일. Z-P2 진행률 33% — 가이드라인 배포부터 취합까지 일정이 촉박합니다.

- [ ] [T-P13] 채용관리솔루션 최신화 + 2027 기획자료 업데이트
- [ ] [Z-P2] 2027 전사 사업계획 가이드라인 초안 — 10/26 재무계획 취합 대비

articles.headline: AI Data Center Backlash Threatens Australia's $70 Billion Dream
articles.body: Community opposition and grid constraints are threatening Australia's ambitions to become a $70 billion AI data-center hub.

articles.headline: Blackstone Profit Drops 9.2% as Higher Rates Curb Dealmaking
articles.body: Blackstone's profit fell 9.2% as higher interest rates and inflation curbed dealmaking, though infrastructure remained its best-performing strategy.

articles.headline: Western Digital Falls as AI Worries Overshadow Solid Outlook
articles.body: Western Digital shares fell despite a solid outlook and dividend hike, as broader AI-demand worries overshadowed the storage maker's results.

articles.headline: Michigan, Ohio Gas Prices Spike Further Amid Refinery Breakdown
articles.body: Gas prices in Michigan and Ohio spiked further as a refinery breakdown tightened supply, adding to inflation concerns alongside rising WTI crude at $99.19.

articles.headline: When Starshield Cut Out, Ukrainian Drones Fell From the Skies
articles.body: An outage of SpaceX's Starshield network grounded Ukrainian drones on the battlefield, underscoring Kyiv's dependence on commercial satellite links in the war.

articles.headline: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion for Deceiving Users
articles.body: A court ordered Meta to pay $25 billion over claims it deceived users about data practices, a fresh blow to the tech giant as its stock slides.

articles.headline: Tech Stocks Lead Wall Street's Slide as the A.I. Rout Resumes
articles.body: Technology shares led a broad market decline, with the Nasdaq dropping 2.60% as investors reassessed the payoff from massive A.I. investments.

articles.headline: Tesla's Profit Slides Even as Its A.I. Ambitions Grow
articles.body: Tesla reported flat revenue and a steep drop in operating profit as heavy spending on A.I. and robotics weighs on margins.

articles.headline: A Start-Up Claims Its A.I. Can Spot Disease Early
articles.body: A health-technology start-up says its A.I. model can flag disease risk early, drawing both excitement and skepticism from clinicians.

articles.headline: Democrats Expand the Midterm Map as the G.O.P. Stumbles
articles.body: Democrats are competing in once-safe Republican districts as the party builds an edge on top issues heading into the midterms.

articles.headline: Arab Americans split on Trump in 2024; a new poll shows a significant shift
articles.body: A new poll shows Arab American voters shifting significantly toward Democrats ahead of the midterms, a reversal from their 2024 split over Trump.

articles.headline: Trump administration deported nearly 1 million through July, report finds
articles.body: The Trump administration deported nearly one million people through July, according to a new report, as it mobilizes 50,000 troops for immigration enforcement.

articles.headline: Elon Musk and AI rivals pledge to give away more than $300 billion
articles.body: Elon Musk and rival AI firms have pledged to give away more than $300 billion, a striking commitment amid growing scrutiny of AI wealth and power.

articles.headline: Democrats expand the House map. Do they have money to deliver?
articles.body: Democrats are expanding their House target map, but questions remain over whether the party has the money to fund races across newly competitive districts.

articles.headline: Some foreign leaders blame migration for France's riots. Macron says that's 'stupid.'
articles.body: French President Macron denounced foreign leaders, including Trump, who blamed migration for the riots, calling the framing 'stupid.'

articles.headline: Medical tests show Pope Leo requires no further treatment for lung cancer
articles.body: Pope Leo's doctors said no further treatment is required for his lung cancer, clearing the way for his planned trip to Latin America next month.

articles.headline: US stocks slide as AI sell-off deepens; Nasdaq falls 2.6%
articles.body: US equities fell as the AI-driven sell-off deepened, with the Nasdaq down 2.60% and the Philadelphia semiconductor index plunging 6.72%.

articles.headline: Trump envoy proposes Ukraine talks and summit with Putin and Xi
articles.body: Steve Witkoff discussed the resumption of peace dialogue with the Russian president, followed by a US-China-Russia meeting next month.

articles.headline: Macron hits out at 'stupid' Trump remarks about riots in France
articles.body: The French president expressed anger after US and other rightwing leaders blamed migrants for violence and looting.

articles.headline: Bessent shrugs off 'systemic' AI risks at closed-door investor conference
articles.body: The Treasury secretary spoke to financiers at a charity event where tickets cost $7,500, downplaying systemic AI risks.

articles.headline: NSA warns on 'critical' cyber vulnerabilities detected using AI
articles.body: Researchers used OpenAI and Google models to find severe faults in software used on a majority of websites around the world.

articles.headline: Netflix's $300bn problem: lack of hits piles pressure on streaming giant
articles.body: A scarcity of breakout hits is piling pressure on Netflix as subscriber growth cools and competition intensifies.
